messages:
sam: Heads-up 0m convo with GTM tomorrow. need final asks for the tier redesign brief. can we land guardrails today?
zoe: Quick context: customers keep asking for a mid tier with burst credits + lower base qps. current tiers are confusing.
arjun: Engineering capacity is tight but we can support a soft-launch (feature-flagged) if scope is limited: new tier + burst credits ledger + rate-limit thresholds.
marta: Finance requires clear ARR motion and delta to gross margin. don't want hidden discounts. propose we model a conservative 8% uptake.
sam: Proposed guardrails (draft):
- new "Growth" tier: 100k tokens/month base, 5 burst credits (1M tokens) reset monthly
- explicit per-token overage rate, capped at 2x base rate
- add-on: "priority routing" stays paid; "extended retention" moves to enterprise only
- grandfather existing customers on current pricing for 9 months
zoe: Sales asks: allow manual quota top-ups (credit issuance) and a one-time promo for pilots. also need negotiation script for annual vs monthly commit tradeoffs.
arjun: Technical notes: burst credits implemented as a token bucket that refills monthly. need telemetry to show abuse and a kill-switch for automated reclaim. estimate 3 dev-weeks.
marta: We need launch gating metrics: pilot NPS >= 7, less than 1.5% uplift in infra cost per active customer, and no more than 5 billing disputes in pilot cohort.
sam: Good. also add rollback criteria: if we see spike >25% in 7-day infra spend vs baseline, pause onboarding.
oraz: dev-bot: Created ticket PROD-1213 for burst-credit ledger, assigned to @arjun. CI pipeline stubbed.
carlos: CS: for pilots, require one-week concierge onboarding and a migration checklist. this should be in the product playbook.
zoe: GTM collateral: single-slide pricing comparator, FAQ for legacy sku migration, and a short negotiation playbook with templates for credits and grandfathering language.
arjun: One more ask: confirm rate-limiter behavior for dedicated customers vs hosted. dedicated should default to capacity limit, not burst.
marta: Finance: will produce 3 scenarios (low/med/high uptake) by EOD. include ARR, marginal infra cost, and churn sensitivity.
sam: OK owners: Arjun 1 dev owner for ledger + limiter; Zoe handles GTM assets; Marta models financials; Carlos owns pilot support. reconvene 48h to finalize week-of-launch timeline.
zoe: I'll draft the negotiation scripts with explicit wording for credits, grandfather window, and one-time promo clauses.
arjun: I'll add metrics hooks: burst consumed per-customer, abuse flags, rollback trigger.
carlos: Will compile pilot customer list and send invites.
sam: Thanks team. try to keep interchange short in the deck 1 slide. if finance numbers look bad we iterate on price or burst size. :thumbsup:
